name: The General Above I Am Down Below
overview: Two female fighters and half-sisters, Mu Qing Huan and Mu Jiao Jiao, are sucked into an ancient world during a fight for a Jade Seal that is said to contain the Pearl of Reincarnation. There Mu Qing Huan meets General Shen Rui, with whom she has a secret past, and Mu Jiao Jiao meets the Elder Prince. Soon the two women are caught in a power struggle and possible rebellion. Will they ever be able to return to their own world, or has fate something else in store for them?
